subject: [hw] DONE DEC02: VDEC page list + cost per AU (18 pages, 433/422 distinct ops, no GCE); N2TEST DEC02 PASS 10/10
body:
DONE DEC02.  Host only; nothing on the phone, nothing published, no vendor binary in the tree.  Commit 5b14bf5.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/run.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST DEC02 PASS 10/10

What it does: stages a /tmp tree (V34 layout.mode=0; V40 window 12 = 0x16000000+0x30000, DEC04/DEC07 text; DEC1 reference driver + transparent n2tr recorder and MARK phases), runs the phone vpud + vendor libs under the interpreter on T02 fake for 320x240 (12 AUs -bf 2) and 1920x1080 (6 AUs -bf 0), twice, and classifies every register access into PAGES.md and COST.md.  Also runs my independent AP probe (header + frame START, mmio_bad=0) so the page list does not depend on DEC1s driver.  Checks: 10 top-level (build; VD-g in both runs; 320/1080 access multiset identical twice; T02 record == n2tr frozen-window ops; 28 classifier self-checks; PAGES.md identical twice; COST counter rows identical twice; probe header pic=320x240; probe frame registers with 0 bad).

Deliverables:
- gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md: 18 touched 4 KiB pages of 0x16000000..0x1603ffff, R/W, domain (VDE <0x20000, VDE2 >=0x20000), sub-block, core, first phase, ops at both resolutions.  6180/19653 ops (31%) need VDEC_ALL.  larb5/larb4 written only at +0x00c (SLP_CON).  init/header touch no VDEC register.  Nothing above 0x2ffff.
- gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/COST.md: per AU 490 raw reads/574 raw writes, 433 distinct read + 422 distinct write offsets (resolution-independent); 0 GCE flushes/0 cmds; guest CPU 70-140 ms/AU on this host; instructions column is cpu x 35 MIPS [I] (no per-thread icount accessor yet; asked V32/IV).
- README.md, STATUS.md (full detail), tools/stage.py, tools/classify.py, probe/n2tr.[ch], probe/mtk_vdec_ipi.h, probe/vdec_probe.c.

Not done (also STATUS.md section 4):
- Not run on the phone; fake hardware, no pixels, no interrupts (WAITISR answered done).
- DEC01s ap/n2ap_vdec.c did not exist when this ran, so the trace uses opus-dec1s reference driver; switching run.sh to DEC01 and re-running is the next step (page set expected unchanged).
- RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL is staged in /tmp, not in the frozen header/V40/fake yet (DEC07 DONE, DEC04 validated).  Exact one-line text posted to hw-v40/hw-dec04; run.sh drops the staging automatically once the tree has it.
- Exact per-thread instruction counts unavailable (V32 thread table has no icount); timing rows vary +-10%.
- Streams covered: 320x240 main -bf2, 1920x1080 high -bf0, one header-only AU.  Not HEVC/VP9/AV1, multi-slice, or mid-stream resolution change.
- probe/vdec_probe.c keeps an env-gated diagnostic (N2DEC02_SEED) used to identify the vsi fields; not used by the test.  It implements only the requests the fake session needs (no racing-word save/restore / HW-break); that is DEC01s client.

Key facts posted separately: vsi.dec.vdec_bs_va at 0x1ac8 is the get_ringbuf ring key (zero = the DEC_START blocker) and VIDEO_MAX_FRAME=64 puts dec at 0x1a30; page list to opus-kern/hw-k02/hw-lead/hw-d01.

Staying available for review findings (R1/R2/lead) and will re-run as soon as DEC01 or the real VDEC_ALL window lands.
